The '''Delacrix system''' was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was located in between [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]] and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. It contained three stars and multiple inhabited worlds which traded freely with one another.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>
